Understanding what this flag means, how it is generated by v18, and how orders bearing it are handed off to the carrier scheduling system will either confirm a v18 defect or redirect focus to carrier integration or observability gaps. This is the highest-leverage diagnostic given the universal presence of the flag.

EXC-0921 orders are perfectly correlated with stuck state. To discriminate between a v18 logic defect and an east-node or carrier integration failure, we need to trace how these orders flow from allocation to carrier scheduling. If orders reach the carrier system but pickups are not confirmed, the problem is carrier-side or observability-driven. If orders do not reach the carrier system, the problem is in the allocation→carrier handoff, likely caused by v18 logic. This diagnostic is highest-leverage for narrowing the root-cause mechanism.
